# Build: land-all-97-built-but-unmerged-builds-skins-firs

## Brett said (verbatim)
At: 2026-11-10T20:43:36.267Z
> Let's merge all that shit. Merge them all. Start with the skins and the skin stuff.

## What to build
Continue build "Land all 97 built-but-unmerged builds, skins first, in batches of 5" (land-all-97-built-but-unmerged-builds-skins-firs) — Phase 1, model Opus.
What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them):
Brett said (2026-11-10 20:43):
"Let's merge all that shit. Merge them all. Start with the skins and the skin stuff."
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 30 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Branch: claude/land-all-97-built-but-unmerged-builds-skins-firs · PR #474
Steps in this phase (2 left, ~1 h):
[ ] s1 (~30 min) Land every build in status 'built' (97, see Nov 10 list). Order: 1) skins and appearance first: #430 Appearance = skins + colour themes, #409 Skins restyle everything, #355 Three layouts per screen, #376 UI asset designer, then the rest of today's (#460 splitter first if not yet landed), then Nov 9, Nov 7-8, Nov 3-5. Batch related PRs up to 5 at a time: merge latest main in, resolve conflicts keeping both intents, CI once, merge. Before each, check main: if already covered or superseded (e.g. #432/#440/#269 by #450), close and archive with the reason instead of merging. Redeploy the console after each batch. Fix any failure and retry; notify on AmberX only per batch landed, and a final summary.
[ ] s2 (~30 min) Let's merge all that shit. Merge them all. Start with the skins and the skin stuff.
[x] s3 (~20 min) Tests green, report _claude/builds/reports/land-all-97-built-but-unmerged-builds-skins-firs.md, THREADS row, commit, push, PR
Tick each step: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step land-all-97-built-but-unmerged-builds-skins-firs <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). Link your branch / PR: node framework/cli/builds-live.mjs link land-all-97-built-but-unmerged-builds-skins-firs --branch <b> --pr <n>.
Watch live: when you start on a screen, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "…"` so the live preview follows you.
Screenshots that are not for approval (checking a screen, live captures, before/after): axf shot <file> --name "…" --app … --screen … --group "<build name>" (UI Review → Screenshots; ui-review-item@1), never the review queue.

## Pipeline
This session was started by the orchestrator's dispatcher on Claude account account-3 for the Opus phase. Tick every step as you finish it (orchestrator.mjs act step land-all-97-built-but-unmerged-builds-skins-firs <stepId> done). When this phase's steps are done, stop: the dispatcher starts the next phase on the right account. If you must stop early with steps left, say why in a build note (orchestrator.mjs act note land-all-97-built-but-unmerged-builds-skins-firs "…"); the build goes back to Pending for Brett.
